name: Cá thác
summary: Cá thác is sold by the kilogram on the harbor streets, and one kitchen also writes it cá hồng thác.
howToEat: Order it by weight. Island seafood is at its best in winter, before the spring spawn.
where: Đường 1/4 and đường Núi Ngọc, the two seafood streets of Cát Bà town.
seoDescription: Cá thác is sold by the kilogram on the harbor streets of Cát Bà.
